versions.changelog:
Sleep Shift Survivor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides shift-specific sleep schedules for night, rotating, and on-call workers based on circadian science.
- Features forward-rotation adaptation, anchor-sleep planning, strategic caffeine cutoff times, and light/dark exposure guidance.
- Offers drowsy-drive risk warnings for post-shift commutes and shift-work disorder screening flags.
- Includes comprehensive CLI commands for schedule setup, sleep plan generation, commute risk assessment, sleep logging, and screening.
- All features are local and informational, designed to support shift workers in managing their sleep and health.
